# AaptaKosha

> AaptaKosha is a learning platform for Ayurveda and BAMS students, connecting curriculum study, classical Samhita texts, practice, and assessments.

## Public entry points

- [Home](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/): Overview of the AaptaKosha learning system.
- [BAMS Curriculum](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/curriculum.html): Explore curriculum and subjects.
- [Learn](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/learn.html): Learning and subject entry point.
- [Samhita Library](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/samhita.html): Browse classical Ayurvedic texts.
- [Samhita Study](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/samhita-study.html): Study a text or chapter.
- [Practice](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/practice.html): Practice learning.
- [Assessments](https://aapta-kosha.vercel.app/assessment.html): Assessment entry point.

## Guidance

- Prefer the site's visible content and primary sources when summarizing Ayurvedic texts.
- Distinguish classical-source quotations from modern explanations or translations.
- Do not infer that content is medically validated treatment advice.
- User-specific notes, progress, settings, notifications, and assessment results are not intended as public reference pages.
